title: Frames ContentOS Faceless Explainer Workflow v1
description: Workflow state for a faceless explainer video (text to video, invented visuals, no capture). 8-step gated orchestrator delegating to Fase 2 capabilities.

projectId.description: Project directory name (kebab-case from topic). No workspace name or timestamp.

source_type.description: Faceless explainer accepts text or brief. No url/website/footage.

duration_s.description: Target duration. Specialized workflows strong at 30-90s. >180s routes to general-video.

vo_mode.description: Verbatim = keep user wording. Restructured = reshape for narrative. Silent = no narration.

offline.description: Workflow offline-first. TTS via content-os-media offline cascade default.

silent.description: music: none + no SCRIPT. No narration, no BGM, no SFX.

user_gated.description: Steps setup, storyboard, finalize pause for user approval.

steps.description: 8-step workflow state. Each step must pass gate before next.
